$comment: S21 Datameet railway schedules (T074). Measure columns added to the common envelope (common.json). Field map: configs/sources/s21.yaml; rules: decision D111.

fields.name: stop_sequence
fields.meaning: 1-based file order within the train (not published; flagged imputed when stop ids disagree)

fields.name: arrival_text
fields.meaning: 2016 timetable arrival HH:MM:SS; null where the file says None (first stops)

fields.name: departure_text
fields.meaning: 2016 timetable departure HH:MM:SS; null where the file says None (last stops)

fields.name: journey_day
fields.meaning: day of the journey (day), 1 for the starting day

fields.name: lat
fields.meaning: station latitude from stations.json; null when the station has no geometry

valid_at: null: a 2016 timetable; never a current time or ETA
kept: stops at stations whose published state is the configured state
